name: שְׁבָא
summary: Three genealogies name a man called Sheba, as a son of Raamah, Joktan or Jokshan. Sheba is also the southern land and people whose queen visited Solomon and whose rulers bring tribute; Arabic knows it as Sabaʾ, the kingdom of Yemen.

evidence.note: The kings of Sheba and Seba bring tribute.
The queen of Sheba hears of Solomon’s fame.

evidence.locator: Book I, p. 1287, art. سبأ, n18634, the people of Yemen
evidence.note: Arabic Sabaʾ, the name of the southern kingdom.

note: Merged with the former word entry `xebaa2`, the land and people (old root key שבא), which added Sheba@1Ki.10.1 and BDB v.al.ag; its Arabic cognate arab-saba (سبأ Sabaʾ) is now the Lane citation in evidence. TIPNR’s Sheba@Gen.10.7 also holds the gentilic Sabeans. The old `entry` named that word entry, which is now this name; there is no root entry.
